text:
Sam: Heads-up — Prospect (AcmeBank) wants a small compliance pack before we start the POC next week: a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, either an ISO/27001 certificate or a formal ISO compliance statement, and a signed pen-test attestation letter they can attach to procurement. They also asked if Dedicated pricing bundles any extra compliance deliverables. Can we confirm what we can provide and lead time?

Anya: We can draft a redacted SOC2 + an internal controls mapping. We don't have a global ISO certificate to hand out, but we can produce an ISO readiness statement + controls crosswalk.

Priya: Security side: we can assemble (1) redacted SOC2 report, (2) controls mapping CSV, (3) optional network/segmentation diagram if they're on Dedicated, and (4) a short pen-test attestation letter. Note: the attestation needs Legal + Security sign-off. If prioritized, estimate ~48 hours to bundle and redaction-check.

Mel: I can sign/approve the attestation, but I need the exact recipient (company/contact/email), the SOW or a one-paragraph engagement summary, and the specific language customer expects. We intentionally keep attestations minimal — no vuln details, no exploit PoCs.

Sam: They said they only need confirmation that an external pentest was completed recently and that there are no outstanding high-severity findings affecting hosted infra. They said they do NOT need the full pen-test report.

Anya: Regarding Dedicated pricing: baseline Dedicated includes a one-time architecture/network review and standard infra docs. Any extra work (longer log retention, bespoke segmentation, or extra attestation work) would be billable as an add-on. I'll draft a small quote for those optional items.

AuditBot: Created ticket COMPL-7384: prepare redacted SOC2, controls mapping, pen-test attestation template, optional network diagram. Owner: Priya. SLA: 48 hours.

Priya: Packing list I'll produce and upload to DLP: redacted SOC2 (pdf), controls_mapping.csv, pen-test_attestation_draft.pdf, network_diagram.png (if requested). Will provide presigned links and note redaction heuristic used.

LegalBot: For attestation wording, we prefer: "Redwood Inference attests that an external penetration test was conducted on [date range] against production-hosted infrastructure; no open high-severity vulnerabilities remained as of [date]." We avoid details about scope/tools/vendors. Attach SOW for signature.

Mel: Once I see the draft and recipient details, I will sign. Also confirm redaction level with Acme — some buyers want more redaction than others.

Sam: I set a quick call with Acme tomorrow 9:30am PT to confirm recipient and acceptable redaction. Will update here after call. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Anya: I'll follow up in this thread after the call with pricing add-on numbers.

Priya: Starting work now, will update COMPL-7384 with links when ready.

Mel: Approved to proceed with drafting. Will hold final signature until SOW and recipient are provided.

Sam: Perfect. If they request the network diagram for Dedicated, please include a high-level L3 view only (no IPs).

Priya: Noted — L3 diagram only. Upload ETA 48h.

Sam: Thanks — will report back after the sync.
